name: chessboard-vanilla-v2
description: Professional full-stack chess puzzle platform with TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and React - 32,000+ puzzles for skill development

scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend-v2 && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend-v2 && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron-start"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:api: npm run payload:generator && node tools/test-api-connectivity-v3.js > api_test_output.txt 2>&1
scripts.test:render: npm run payload:generator && node tools/test-render-api-connectivity.js > render_api_test_output.txt 2>&1
scripts.frontend:workflow: rm -rf frontend-v2/src && npm run frontend:generator && npm run copy:prod && npm run index:generator frontend-v2/src && npm run build:v2
scripts.postinstall: cd backend-v2 && npm install && cd ../frontend-v2 && npm install
